description: This file defines the Complex class for managing complex numbers, including properties, methods for retrieving real and imaginary parts, string formatting, validation, and method calls for complex number operations and functions.

classes.name: Complex
classes.description: A class representing complex numbers with properties for real and imaginary parts, methods for validation, formatting, and performing complex operations via magic method calls.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing complex number with real and imaginary parts, possibly parsing from string or array input.

methods.name: getReal
methods.description: Returns the real part of the complex number.

methods.name: getImaginary
methods.description: Returns the imaginary part of the complex number.

methods.name: getSuffix
methods.description: Returns the suffix ('i' or 'j') of the complex number.

methods.name: isReal
methods.description: Checks if the complex number is purely real.

methods.name: isComplex
methods.description: Checks if the complex number has an imaginary part.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the complex number.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Magic method to convert the complex number to a string.

methods.name: validateComplexArgument
methods.description: Validates and converts an argument into a Complex object.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Returns the reciprocal of the complex number.

methods.name: invertImaginary
methods.description: Returns the complex number with inverted imaginary component.

methods.name: invertReal
methods.description: Returns the complex number with inverted real component.
